title: NeuroMetBench reproducibility package
description: NeuroMetBench is a patient-aware evidence-bounding methodology for evaluating transcript-derived metabolic representations across heterogeneous proteogenomic contexts. Version 2.1.2 adds revision-stage patient-influence and pathway-specificity stress tests, an internally preanalysis-frozen orthogonal measured-metabolomics sensitivity in the Wang/CPTAC glioblastoma cohort, and a recovered reaction-identity/artifact-integrity firewall for historical METAFlux outputs. The new evidence is deliberately asymmetric: LSCC pathway specificity is supported exploratorily, CNS specificity replication is not supported, and correspondence between the transcript-derived serine score and measured L-serine remains weak and uncertain. Historical solver optimality/KKT evidence is not reconstructed, and prior adverse results and claim ceilings remain preserved. Licensing is mixed by file: NeuroMetBench-authored material is MIT-licensed, while the minimal redistributed cBioPortal/Wang-CPTAC input subset remains under ODbL 1.0. The Zenodo record should declare both licenses.
